# ByteGLB
> Browser-based 3D model optimization and conversion tools focused on GLB, glTF, and related asset workflows.

ByteGLB provides web tools for compressing, converting, and preparing 3D assets for web delivery, with supporting pages for features, pricing, help, and product information.

## Core Tools
- [GLB Compressor](https://www.byteglb.com/glb-compressor): Compress GLB files to reduce size for faster loading and delivery.
- [GLTF Compressor](https://www.byteglb.com/gltf-compressor): Optimize glTF assets for smaller downloads and improved runtime performance.
- [3D Model Converter](https://www.byteglb.com/3d-model-converter): Convert 3D models between common formats for web and production workflows.
- [OBJ to GLB](https://www.byteglb.com/obj-to-glb): Convert OBJ models into compact GLB files for modern viewers.
- [FBX to GLB](https://www.byteglb.com/fbx-to-glb): Transform FBX assets into GLB format for web-friendly distribution.
- [STL to GLB](https://www.byteglb.com/stl-to-glb): Convert STL geometry into GLB for interactive visualization and sharing.

## Format Conversion
- [GLB to OBJ](https://www.byteglb.com/glb-to-obj): Export GLB assets into OBJ format for compatibility with legacy tools.
- [GLB to FBX](https://www.byteglb.com/glb-to-fbx): Convert GLB models into FBX for editing in DCC applications.
- [GLB to STL](https://www.byteglb.com/glb-to-stl): Generate STL files from GLB assets for fabrication or CAD workflows.
- [GLTF to GLB](https://www.byteglb.com/gltf-to-glb): Package glTF assets into binary GLB format for simpler deployment.
- [GLB to GLTF](https://www.byteglb.com/glb-to-gltf): Extract GLB content into glTF form for editable asset pipelines.
- [USDZ Converter](https://www.byteglb.com/usdz-converter): Convert compatible 3D assets for Apple AR Quick Look experiences.

## Optimization Features
- [Mesh Optimization](https://www.byteglb.com/features/mesh-optimization): Reduce geometry complexity while preserving visual fidelity where possible.
- [Texture Compression](https://www.byteglb.com/features/texture-compression): Compress embedded textures to lower asset size and bandwidth usage.
- [Draco Compression](https://www.byteglb.com/features/draco-compression): Apply Draco geometry compression to supported 3D assets.
- [KHR Texture BasisU](https://www.byteglb.com/features/khr-texture-basisu): Use Basis Universal texture encoding for efficient GPU-friendly delivery.
- [Batch Processing](https://www.byteglb.com/features/batch-processing): Process multiple 3D files in one workflow for higher throughput.
- [Web Viewer Compatibility](https://www.byteglb.com/features/web-viewer-compatibility): Prepare assets for use in browser-based 3D viewers and apps.

- [How to Compress GLB Files](https://www.byteglb.com/guides/how-to-compress-glb-files): Step-by-step guidance for reducing GLB file sizes effectively.
- [How to Convert OBJ to GLB](https://www.byteglb.com/guides/how-to-convert-obj-to-glb): Walk through converting OBJ assets into GLB format.
- [How to Convert FBX to GLB](https://www.byteglb.com/guides/how-to-convert-fbx-to-glb): Learn the basic workflow for turning FBX files into GLB.
- [GLB vs glTF](https://www.byteglb.com/guides/glb-vs-gltf): Compare binary GLB and JSON-based glTF packaging approaches.
- [Best Practices for Web 3D Assets](https://www.byteglb.com/guides/web-3d-best-practices): Recommendations for optimizing models for browser delivery.
- [Preparing Models for AR](https://www.byteglb.com/guides/preparing-models-for-ar): Tips for creating lightweight assets suitable for AR viewers.
